question: The value of the determinant $\begin{vmatrix}6&0&-1\\ 2&1&4\\ 1&1&3\end{vmatrix}$ is
explanation:
**Step 1:** Expand the determinant along the first row: $D = 6 \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 4 \\ 1 & 3 \end{vmatrix} - 0 \begin{vmatrix} 2 & 4 \\ 1 & 3 \end{vmatrix} - 1 \begin{vmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 1 & 1 \end{vmatrix}$.

**Step 2:** Calculate the 2x2 minors: $D = 6(3 - 4) - 0 - 1(2 - 1)$.

**Step 3:** Simplify the final expression: $D = 6(-1) - 1(1) = -6 - 1 = -7$.
